create_injected_traceable_decorator: create a decorator that traces class methods by dynamically fetching a tracer from the instance
use_injected_traceable_with_tags: use the injected_traceable decorator with custom tags to label traced method calls
use_injected_traceable_with_trace_type: use the injected_traceable decorator with a trace_type parameter to specify the trace kind
use_injected_traceable_with_metadata: use the injected_traceable decorator with meta_data to attach additional context to traces
review_injected_traceable_fallback: review the injected_traceable decorator fallback behavior when no tracer attribute is found on the instance
